summary: A Kingsway dental practice appears to lose new patients to leftover template text, repeated paragraphs and a free builder address.

findings.problem: The page text appears to include leftover template wording such as please mention any other equipment's.
findings.cost: Template notes on a dental page make the practice look unfinished.
findings.fix: Real equipment details in place of template notes.

findings.problem: Paragraphs such as At Miranda Dental clinic we are dedicated to providing our patients with highest quality of dental care appear twice.
findings.cost: Repeated copy wastes the visitor's attention and looks careless.
findings.fix: One clear version of each message.

findings.problem: Typos such as dentistsadhere and appointmen appear in the page text.
findings.cost: Spelling errors in a clinic's own text weaken trust.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, and no online booking form or WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book online or message cannot, and a free builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain, online booking and WhatsApp.
